419:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I'm glad for you, $$メール$$. $$ランド$$ and $$ガンレオン$$ made it over the wall.」

419:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For all your devoted work backing him up from behind the scenes, $$メール$$, please allow me to present you with this.」

419:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. With these, even you, $$メール$$, will be able to stand up to $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

419:t_10:29.en:
$$メール$$
「I get it! I pop the balloons right in front of the enemy, and attack while they're startled, right!」

419:t_10:31.en:
$$メール$$
「I'll go put them on $$ガンレオン$$ right away. Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$!」

419:t_10:33.en:
$$メール$$
「Oh, sorry! I forgot something important!」

419:t_10:34.en:
$$メール$$
「Let's give it our all again today!」

419:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Making $$メール$$ cry is not something I will allow, $$ランド$$...」

420:t_000:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Still, those $$サイデリアル$$ guys... I can't believe they keep coming back without learning their lesson.」

420:t_000:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Quit grumbling, quit grumbling. It's going to be our last battle at the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, so let's go all out.」

420:t_001:3.en:
$$レド$$
「It's the effect of $$ランド$$'s special training.」

420:t_001:4.en:
$$メルティ$$
「I'm counting on you, hunks!」

420:t_001:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「A whole fleet's worth of cheering squad, huh.」

420:t_001:7.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$... Why did you pick me as your partner?」

420:t_001:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Since I was taking care of $$レド$$ anyway. Next is your smile training.」

420:t_001:11.en:
$n
「Well... it may not be my place to say, but...」

420:t_001:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like he hit the mark.」

420:t_001:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$ランド$$... Lately, you've been acting a little strange.」

420:t_001:16.en:
$$桂$$
「That's not like you, $$ランド$$. You, worried about something.」

420:t_001:17.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Is it about $$ガンレオン$$ after all?」

420:t_001:18.en:
$$ランド$$
「We'll talk about that later. Looks like someone I don't want to see has shown up.」

420:t_003:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「He really never learns, that bastard.」

420:t_003:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Be careful. Knowing that man... he's bound to have some scheme ready.」

420:t_003:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The bitter gall you've made me swallow until now...! I'll repay it here, double... no, tenfold!」

420:t_003:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「The exaggeration typical of a third-rater.」

420:t_003:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'm sick and tired of your face and your dirty tricks!」

420:t_003:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Can you keep up that bravado after seeing this?!」

420:t_004:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the heck is that?!」

420:t_004:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Scorpion venom...! It's the same as $$バルビエル$$'s venom!」

420:t_004:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Exactly! The hypnotic waves emitted from it amplify the hatred sleeping inside humans!」

420:t_004:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$バルビエル$$ adds the power of a $$スフィア$$ to that to induce powerful hypnosis, but a copy that only imitates the form won't work on us!」

420:t_004:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I knew that all along! ...But how about the foolish masses who have nothing to do with fighting?!」

420:t_004:7.en:
$$レド$$
「This is bad! The $$ガルガンティア船団$$...!」

420:t_004:8.en:
$$メルティ$$
「...Hey, did that guy do something?」

420:t_004:9.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Dunno... I'm a little... irritated, but nothing special has changed.」

420:t_004:11.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Don't worry about us! Put everything into taking those guys out!」

420:t_004:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, hey, mushroom bastard! Dunno what you wanted to do, but looks like it was all for nothing!」

420:t_004:13.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-What is the meaning of this?!」

420:t_004:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Could it be... the people of the fleet have no hatred in their hearts...?」

420:t_004:17.en:
$$リジット$$
「It's not that we don't know the feeling called hatred either...」
